instruction: I'd like to stream this video link through VLC: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fJ9rUzIMcZQ

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation of VLC streaming task with a different YouTube video URL (Queen - Bohemian Rhapsody). Uses the same evaluator pattern (is_vlc_playing with url type). Instruction is paraphrased while maintaining the same task complexity.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is playing AND the correct URL is loaded
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) properly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface to status.xml
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly parses XML, checks playing state, and performs URL matching with multiple fallback strategies
Expected URL matches the instruction URL exactly
Data flow is correct: getter extracts state → metric compares URL → returns score
Good edge case handling: checks for missing URL info, various URL formats, and parsing errors
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: YouTube URLs may be transformed by VLC when streaming (e.g., extracting actual video stream URL). The metric has fallback URL matching logic, but it's unclear if it will catch all YouTube URL transformations. Consider testing with actual YouTube streaming to verify URL matching works in practice.
Consider logging the actual URL found in VLC status XML during evaluation to help debug URL matching issues
